correctness.rationale: Exhaustive two-route simplex enumeration yields 1037 nonempty faces. An explicit acyclic 506-pair discrete matching leaves cells in degrees 0,3,4 with multiplicities 1,23,1. A chain reduction with 506 integral unit pivots has primitive four-to-three boundary, yielding an integral wedge of 22 three-spheres; the homotopy step uses \(\pi_3( igvee^{23}S^3)=\mathbb Z^{23}\). Exhaustive 12-automorphism enumeration and signed Lefschetz fixed-simplex traces yield the rational character. Actual files verify.py and verification_output.txt checked.
